Experience: Software Engineering Intern at Prodapt Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Chennai from February 2026 to June 2026. Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) track, completing intensive corporate training in Python, SQL, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and software engineering best practices.

Prodapt Capstone Project: Built an LLM-powered Insurance Claims Investigation Platform using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, ChromaDB, and SQLite to automate claim analysis and fraud investigation. Designed a multi-step LangGraph agent workflow orchestrating claim intake, fraud detection, similar-claim retrieval, risk assessment, and explainable AI recommendation generation.

Prodapt Experience: Built a hybrid RAG pipeline using Sentence Transformers embeddings in ChromaDB, combining semantic and keyword (BM25) search for historical claim retrieval. Integrated a Scikit-learn Random Forest fraud-risk model with SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) explainability into the LLM workflow for evidence-based, auditable decisions.
Prodapt Experience: Architected REST APIs (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy) to orchestrate LLM agent calls, claim CRUD operations, and report generation, following Agile SDLC with Git.

Experience: Web Development Intern at CurrentEdge Systems Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore from May 2025 to June 2025. Developed backend modules using Node.js and Express.js for enterprise web applications. Engineered adaptive frontend interfaces and product views using Next.js and Material UI, deployed directly to production. Architected and tested REST APIs using Postman and utilized Git within Agile workflows.

Technical Skills - Databases: MongoDB, SQLite, MySQL, ChromaDB. Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy.

Technical Skills - Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, AWS (basics), Vercel. CS Fundamentals: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Operating Systems (OS), Database Management Systems (DBMS), System Design, Debugging, Agile.

Context-aware, policy-grounded responses via RAG, and transparent, auditable reasoning traces.
